craft_notes: Sthāyin: śeṣavṛtti unit 62. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 9. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: That very in supreme in abode wise should offer for worship; in hymns in many ways and this by me spoken in own āhnika.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tameva parame dhāmni pūjanāyārpayedbudhaḥ stotreṣu bahudhā caitanmayā proktaṃ nijāhnike
